51129767.protein: HLA class I histocompatibility antigen, A alpha chain
51129767.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human biotinylated HLA-A2 by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) experiments were performed on a Biacore T200 instrument (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. Human biotinylated HLA-A2 was immobilized on a streptavidin-coated sensor chip (SA sensor chip, GE Healthcare) at a density of ~1000 response units (RU). The immobilized HLA-A2 was blocked with 10 mM ethanolamine (pH 8.5) for 10 min. The compounds were dissolved in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4) and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The association phase lasted for 120 s, followed by a 120 s dissociation phase. The sensor chip was regenerated with 10 mM glycine-HCl (pH 2.0) for 30 s after each cycle. The binding data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare) with a steady-state affinity model to determine the equilibrium dissociation constant (K_D).
original_paragraph.Figure 4 caption: Fig. 4. Direct binding analysis by SPR. Binding affinities (K_D values) of seven hits to the immobilized HLA-A2 proteins were determined by fitting the SPR data with steady-state affinity model.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4)
